hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: We answer your questions before you have to ask.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: The cost depends on the scope and services selected. Our budget calculator shows estimates per service. For an exact price, contact us and we'll send a proposal within 24 hours.

items.q: How long does it take to complete?
items.a: It depends on the service: a landing page can be ready in 5-7 business days, a full website in 2-4 weeks, and a mobile app or AI project in 4-8 weeks. Exact timelines are agreed in the proposal.

items.q: Do you work with clients worldwide?
items.a: Yes. We work 100% remotely with clients in any country. We communicate via video call, chat and email, and adapt meeting times to your timezone.
All projects include 30 days of free support for minor corrections after delivery. After that, you can subscribe to one of our monthly maintenance plans.
Yes. From your account in the 'My account' section you can see your order status in real time. We also send email updates at each project milestone.
The number of revisions depends on the plan. We generally include 2 to 4 feedback rounds to make sure the result is exactly what you need.

items.q: Do I need a domain to get started?
items.a: Not required. We can help you register and configure a domain, or you can bring your own. If you already have hosting, we work with it too.
Yes. For larger projects we offer staged payments: typically a percentage upfront, another at the midpoint, and the rest on final delivery.
Prices shown are before taxes. The final total, including any applicable taxes based on your country, is detailed in the personalised quote.
Browse our Services page, request a service via the order form, or message us directly through the chat or contact form. We respond within 24 hours.
